title: AFP-Enterprise: Evaluating Host-Level Runtime Containment for Planner–Tool Execution
description: Technical report for AFP-Enterprise: a host runtime kernel beside a local planner, reached by a pre-flight probe. Specifies an emergency stop, depth cap, four-axis pressure isolate, and isolate–recover machine. Records laptop planner–tool traces: bounded-job completion, loop/burst containment, and a three-way baseline against a per-step wipe. Traces fire the depth cap and hard isolate; leftover telemetry is the measured increment, not identity-locked persistence. No repository hyperlinks.
